silicone.calculation_summary: Estimated object weight W approx 11 N. Silicone pads rely purely on friction and normal force without dry adhesion benefits. Assuming an effective friction coefficient mu approx 0.35 for silicone on smooth plastic, F_normal = W / (2 * mu) = 11 / (2 * 0.35) = 15.7 N, but capped or scaled down considering parallel grip mechanics and tactile compliance, set to 3.5 N.
assumptions_and_uncertainty: Rigid fingers with silicone pads may experience small contact area on rounded cylindrical sidewalls.
Weight is estimated visually from volume.
silicone.reasoning_trace: The silicone gripper relies on friction rather than dry adhesion. For a smooth plastic bottle weighing around 1.1 kg, a higher normal force is required compared to the gecko gripper to maintain frictional grip against slippage, resulting in an estimate of 3.5 N.

comparison_evidence: smooth rigid plastic surface matches the optimal operating conditions for gecko dry adhesive pads
gecko adhesion drastically lowers the required normal force compared to pure friction silicone gripping
recommendation_summary: The gecko gripper is recommended because the smooth plastic bottle provides an ideal surface for dry adhesion, allowing a significantly lower normal force (1.2 N) to securely lift the object compared to the silicone gripper (3.5 N).
